questions.question: [image-based question: picture of a tick, looked like Dermacentor]

parts.text: Name 1 infection associated with this tick.

questions.model_answer: Dermacentor tick (dog tick/wood tick) - associated with Rocky Mountain spotted fever (Rickettsia rickettsii); also transmits tularemia (Francisella tularensis) and Colorado tick fever.

parts.text: Ixodes scapularis. Name one virus, one parasite, 2 bacteria that are transmitted by this vector.

questions.model_answer: Ixodes scapularis transmitted pathogens: Virus - Powassan virus (deer tick virus). Parasite - Babesia microti (babesiosis). Two bacteria: Borrelia burgdorferi (Lyme disease) and Anaplasma phagocytophilum (human granulocytic anaplasmosis); Borrelia miyamotoi (relapsing fever-like illness) also acceptable as an alternate second bacterium.
